description: Merges pairs of polyphonic notes into one voice and slides between them: as the volume moves from one note to the other, the pitch and the modulation follow it across

params.text: Sets one end of the range of intervals that may glide, 1 to 127 semitones. With the minimum at or above the maximum the range inverts, the red lamp lights, and the intervals between are left out.
Sets one end of the range of notes that may glide. With the lowest-note knob at or above the highest-note knob the range inverts, the red lamp lights, and the notes between them are left out.

inputs.text: How loud each note is, one polyphonic channel per note; the balance between two notes' volumes is how far their glide has travelled, and this jack sets the channel count of all three outputs
The pitches of the notes, one volt per octave, one polyphonic channel per note
While a cable is here, a new note only joins a glide if the voltage is above 0V; with nothing patched every new note may join one
A modulation value for each note, one polyphonic channel per note, carried across the glide in step with the pitch

outputs.text: The volume of each merged voice, the two notes added together
The pitch of each merged voice, one volt per octave, moving between the two notes in proportion to their volumes
The modulation of each merged voice, moving between the two notes in proportion to their volumes

notes: nothing comes out until the volume input is patched, together with either the pitch input and pitch output or the modulation input and modulation output.
with less than that patched, the module clears its note mapping and sets every output to no channels.
a glide starts when a second note arrives over a sounding one, both notes fall inside the note range, and the interval between them falls inside the interval range.
the two notes then share one output channel until the first of them is released.
the two red lamps light to say their range has been turned inside out; they are not controls and cannot be clicked.
the module has no menu of its own beyond Rack's.

inputs.0:
0 to 10V · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
1V per octave · continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V.
inputs.2:
high above 0V · stepped · one channel only

unpatched it reads every note may join a glide.
